messages:
marta: quick handoff from Scarab-11B bring-up (fp16 / INT8 / INT7) on the GTN conversational+extract slices. compact summary for product + runtime.
kevin: TL;DR plz.
marta: TL;DR: INT7 gives biggest cost wins but shows concentrated regressions on multi-turn instruction and table extraction. INT8 is the pragmatic default — small quality hit, solid cost win. fp16 for high-fidelity/extraction.
yara: can we get $/1k + perf deltas?
marta: unit econ (includes batching + prefix cache effects): fp16 = $1.00 / 1k tokens; INT8 = $0.49 / 1k; INT7 = $0.31 / 1k.
kevin: quality deltas (macro-F1 on GTN slices vs fp16): INT8 -0.4 pts; INT7 -2.7 pts. hallucination probe (n=1k): INT8 +0.5% abs, INT7 +1.9% abs.
yara: latency p95?
marta: p95 baseline fp16=200ms, INT8=212ms (+12ms), INT7=265ms (+65ms) due to extra KV reassembly CPU tail in INT7 path.
dev-bot: smoke results: PASS. quant-kernel-errors: 0. kvcache-hit-delta: INT8 -1.3%, INT7 -5.6%.
kevin: product wants a single metric. i propose "CompassLite" = 0.65*Quality_norm + 0.25*CostSavings_norm + 0.10*InvLatency_norm. higher is better. norms relative to fp16, cost savings scaled so larger savings -> higher.
marta: paste normalized snapshot:
```
Variant | Quality_norm | CostSavings_norm | InvLatency_norm | CompassLite
fp16    | 1.00         | 0.00             | 1.00            | 1.00
INT8    | 0.996        | 0.51             | 0.943          | 0.996*0.65 + 0.51*0.25 + 0.943*0.10 = 0.92
INT7    | 0.973        | 0.81             | 0.755          | = 0.89
```
(note: cost inversion so bigger CostSavings_norm = better)
yara: CompassLite tilts to INT8. product will want recommended default + routing rules + a one-row scorecard.
marta: recommendation: default -> INT8 for Scarab-11B in GTN beta. Route to fp16 when signals indicate: `task==\"extraction\" || metadata.context_tokens>3500 || slice in [\"legal\",\"contracts\"]`. Keep INT7 shadowed at 8% for data collection; do NOT promote until KV-reassembly and kernel fixes land.
kevin: runtime snippet for rules (pasteable):
```
if metadata.slice in ["legal","contracts"] or metadata.context_tokens>3500 or metadata.task=="extraction":
    model = "fp16"
elif metadata.traffic_tier=="bulk_low_risk":
    model = "INT7"
else:
    model = "INT8"
```
marta: canary plan: start INT8 default at 5% (swap from fp16), ramp to 35% over 48h if no regressions. shadow INT7 at 8% to collect failing cases. canary flag: `feature.gtn.scarab11b.quant_canary = 0.05`. dashboards: https://dash.redwood/boards/scarab-compasslite
product-ela: please give me a 2-line blurb for GTN onboarding doc and a one-line scorecard row.
marta: blurb: "Recommend INT8 for Scarab-11B as the default for GTN beta to balance cost and fidelity. Route extraction-heavy, legal/contract, and very long-context requests to fp16. INT7 is shadow-only pending kernel fixes."
scorecard: [Variant, CostPer1k, DeltaF1, p95_ms] -> INT8, $0.49, -0.4pt, +12ms; INT7, $0.31, -2.7pt, +65ms; fp16, $1.00, 0pt, baseline.
kevin: follow-ups: 1) PR to gtn/docs with blurb + scorecard (product-ela) 2) runtime ticket for INT7 KV reassembly & kernel work (assign runtime team) 3) schedule 48h canary review (dev-bot).
dev-bot: scheduled re-eval job at 3976580000 to re-run metrics after kernel attempts.
yara: thanks everyone  clean handoff. :thumbsup:
product-ela: will open PR and loop in legal/product for sign-off.
kevin: added TODO: include fallback telemetry bucket for any route->fp16 events to track missed signals.
marta: noted and added to runtime ticket. thanks all.
